LanguageData.DrumBathHygiene_NoDbhTitle: Drum Bath Hygiene: no Dubs Bad Hygiene
LanguageData.DrumBathHygiene_NoDbhText: Drum Bath Hygiene needs Dubs Bad Hygiene (Workshop 836308268) or Dubs Bad Hygiene Lite (Workshop 2570319432), and neither is active. Without one of them this mod does nothing.\n\nActivate one of the two, never both: Lite replaces the full mod.
